questions.question: A ball of mass 2 kg is dropped from a height of 20 m. After hitting the ground, it bounces back to a height of 5 m. The energy lost is:
questions.explanation: Initial PE = mgh1 = 2*10*20 = 400 J. Final PE = mgh2 = 2*10*5 = 100 J. Loss = 400 - 100 = 300 J.

questions.question: The kinetic energy of a body moving with velocity v is E. If the velocity is made 3v, the new kinetic energy will be:
questions.explanation: KE is proportional to the square of velocity. (3v)^2 = 9v^2, so KE becomes 9 times.

questions.question: A block of mass 5 kg is pushed 2 m along a horizontal surface by a force of 20 N. If the surface is frictionless, the work done is:
questions.explanation: Work = Force * Displacement = 20 * 2 = 40 Joules.

hi.explanation: कार्य = बल * विस्थापन = 20 * 2 = 40 जूल।

questions.explanation: Since displacement is zero, work done (W = F * s) is also zero.

questions.question: A 100 W bulb is used for 10 hours. The energy consumed in kWh is:
questions.explanation: Energy = Power * Time = 100W * 10h = 1000 Wh = 1 kWh.

hi.question: एक 100 वाट का बल्ब 10 घंटे के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। kWh में खपत ऊर्जा है:
hi.explanation: ऊर्जा = शक्ति * समय = 100W * 10h = 1000 Wh = 1 kWh।

questions.question: In an inelastic collision, which of the following is NOT conserved?
questions.explanation: While momentum and total energy are always conserved, KE is lost in inelastic collisions.

hi.question: एक अप्रत्यास्थ टक्कर में, निम्नलिखित में से क्या संरक्षित नहीं रहता है?
hi.explanation: जबकि संवेग और कुल ऊर्जा हमेशा संरक्षित रहते हैं, अप्रत्यास्थ टक्करों में KE की हानि होती है।

questions.question: The potential energy of a body at height h is mgh. What is its KE when it reaches the ground?
questions.explanation: By conservation of energy, all initial PE is converted into KE at the ground level.

hi.question: ऊँचाई h पर एक वस्तु की स्थितिज ऊर्जा mgh है। जमीन पर पहुँचने पर इसकी KE क्या होगी?
hi.explanation: ऊर्जा संरक्षण के द्वारा, सभी प्रारंभिक PE जमीनी स्तर पर KE में परिवर्तित हो जाती है।

questions.question: A body is moving in a vertical circle. The minimum velocity at the lowest point to complete the circle is:
questions.explanation: To maintain tension at the top, the velocity at the bottom must be at least sqrt(5gr).

questions.question: Work done by a conservative force is equal to:
questions.explanation: W_cons = -ΔU (Negative of change in potential energy).

hi.question: एक संरक्षी बल द्वारा किया गया कार्य किसके बराबर होता है?
hi.explanation: W_cons = -ΔU (स्थितिज ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन का ऋणात्मक)।

questions.explanation: PE = 1/2 kx^2. It depends on spring constant and extension, not on the attached mass.
